title: Validating Hybrid-State Cache Recovery for GLM-5.3-Flash with vLLM and LMCache
abstract: arXiv:2609.15030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: External cache transfers can succeed while a hybrid language model resumes from an inconsistent state. We examine the full 45-layer GLM-5.3-Flash model, using the RedHatAI/ GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 quantized checkpoint with vLLM and LMCache under four-way tensor parallelism. A complete-hit recovery mismatch restored state for the full prompt while the scheduler credited one fewer token. We aligned recovery through strict-prefix lookup and established a numerical comparison using shared computation corrections, matched checkpoint scheduling, and fixed per-rank kernel configurations. In a nine-length serial workload, agreement with the modified recomputation control improved from 34/36 to 36/36 generations, each containing 64 token IDs. A separate instrumented run passed recorded transfer-page, effective-tail, and delayed-save checks. Three additional synthetic templates passed 72 paired 256-token continuations across two fresh-container runs

translated_title: 使用 vLLM 和 LMCache 验证 GLM-5.3-Flash 的混合状态缓存恢复
translated_abstract: 外部缓存传输可能在成功的同时，使混合语言模型从不一致的状态恢复。我们研究了完整的45层GLM-5.3-Flash模型，使用RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4量化检查点，在四路张量并行下配合vLLM和LMCache运行。我们发现了一个完全命中恢复不匹配问题：系统恢复了完整提示的状态，而调度器却少记了一个token。我们通过严格前缀查找对齐了恢复过程，并利用共享计算修正、匹配的检查点调度以及固定的每秩内核配置建立了数值比较方法。在九长度的串行工作负载中，与修改后的重计算控制的生成一致性从34/36提升到了36/36，每个生成包含64个token ID。另一次插桩运行通过了记录的传输页、有效尾部和延迟保存检查。三个额外的合成模板在两次全新容器运行中通过了72组配对的256-token续写测试。
tldr: 该论文通过严格前缀查找、共享计算修正和匹配的检查点调度等方法，验证并修复了GLM-5.3-Flash混合模型在vLLM和LMCache下缓存恢复的状态不一致问题，使生成结果与重计算基准的一致性从34/36提升到36/36。
en_tdlr: This paper validates and fixes inconsistent hybrid-state cache recovery for the GLM-5.3-Flash model under vLLM and LMCache using strict-prefix lookup, shared computation corrections, and matched checkpoint scheduling, improving generation agreement from 34/36 to 36/36.
